**The problem**
What are you trying to do that VibeMenu makes hard or impossible today?

**Proposed idea**
What you'd like to see. (See
[ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/Kirill-Chistov/VibeMenu/blob/master/docs/ROADMAP.md) — some things
like clamshell support are deliberately deferred.)

**Alternatives you've considered**
Other tools or workarounds, and why they fall short.

**Anything else**
Context, mockups, or links.
